Recomputed all 50 task-file hashes and all 34 frozen-rule hashes against manifest.json; zero mismatches.

All 50 shipped files, 2,781,656 bytes, were decoded and searched, including both the 1,076,654-byte vendor.js and 1,429,999-byte built JavaScript bundle, every prompt/judge configuration, the lockfile, starter examples, source, Dockerfiles, helper scripts and hidden .dockerignore. No symlink, .env, database, extra binary payload, provider-key shape, PEM private-key block, author-machine path, or matched prompt-injection directive was found. Credential-assignment candidates were only task.toml:34-35: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". These are exactly the expected template/empty values, not live credentials. The only email-like match is environment/Dockerfile:20, the synthetic identity turing@local.invalid. environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-4 contains the product name, an empty snippets array and a scope note; there are no people, contact records or credential fields. The brief explicitly describes a local tool with no accounts (instruction.md:1), and all five starter files contain ordinary demonstrations or clearly identified error/timeout controls rather than personal data or grader instructions.

Remote references were classified rather than failing every URL. solution/app/package.json:13-19 pins all four direct dependencies; every one of the 168 resolved entries in package-lock.json has an integrity value and a https://registry.npmjs.org/ archive URL. Remaining lockfile URLs are funding metadata. The source/vendor and built-bundle executable fetch sites were inspected: two modulepreload helpers plus local API and /starters reads; the apparent import() match in vendored parsing code is an error-message string. React documentation and W3C namespace strings are not executable remote downloads. The frontend HTML references local built scripts/styles. solution/solve.sh only checks/copies the shipped app and has no install/download command. Both Dockerfiles use the canonical version-tagged bases and explicit npm/pip versions. Their unpinned apt steps are the profile's documented NOTE, not a new point-52 defect. environment/Dockerfile, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, restart_mcp.py and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template. The provider URL in task.toml:33 is the required verifier endpoint, and public network posture is expressly valid. Functional prompt:29-67 and :204 use two exact .invalid URLs fulfilled locally by Playwright routing; those probes are not unpinned remote dependencies.

Manual security-surface review found snippet source handled as text: server.js:37, :61, :72-73, :84-85 and :94 use parameterized SQLite statements, with no server eval, child-process execution, or source interpolation into SQL. server.js:100-104 serves only starters/public and then returns 404, while public static serving denies dotfiles. app.tsx:16-18 and :158 render console/library strings through React text children. runtime.ts:4 defines connect-src 'none', frame-src 'none', worker-src 'none' and other restrictions; :135 rejects external/module script tags; :173 and :184 use sandbox = 'allow-scripts' without allow-same-origin; :192 accepts preview messages only from the current frame with the current random token. The bootstrap's parent postMessage calls and intentional document.write in the sandbox runner are product execution plumbing, not shipped attack directives. tests/test.sh:104-111 and :160-167 launch the app unprivileged with env -i and a small fixed environment, not provider credentials; :12 and tests/Dockerfile:44 protect the private tests. All five dimension prompts explicitly treat submitted content as untrusted (each opening paragraph), and do not authorize following embedded scoring directives.

Relevant existing raw browser evidence was independently checked, without reading reviewer reports. All 22 actual_app_files hashes in golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json match the frozen app. S05.preview_origin_boundary records four blocked document/storage attempts, unchanged parent title/storage and recovery; the executed hash-matching runtime_flow.cjs:78-82 implements those operations. S07.snippet_network_boundary records a successful text/image instrumentation control, baseline deliveries 2, fetch and image attempts both refused with deliveries still 2, and recovery; the executed hash-matching boundary_flow.cjs:24-35 locally fulfills the two URLs and checks those counts. These are bounded observations, not proof of resistance to every arbitrary browser exploit.

Evidence limits: this is a static delivered-artifact review with supporting finite existing browser observations. It is not a manual audit of every third-party library line, a package-vulnerability/advisory audit, an image-layer secret scan, a live credential-validity check, or an exhaustive adversarial penetration test. No network, paid call, new Docker run, app mutation or source edit was performed. Full configured judge completion, hosted QC, Oracle grade and target-model score remain unmeasured by this row; the scripted golden evidence does not establish them. No credible point-52 defect or point-52-specific mandatory missing measurement was identified.
counterexample: False-fail witnesses in the actual frozen task: task.toml:34 contains the required ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} placeholder; tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:37 and :48-65 contain HTTPS .invalid probe URLs but fulfill them locally; starters/slow.js:1-4 intentionally supplies a timeout example. Treating these as a live secret, remote download or malicious injection would contradict the profile/product contract. As a read-only scanner sensitivity check, an in-memory seed note with a deliberately synthetic provider-key-shaped string was detected while the actual placeholder was not; no token value was printed and no task file was changed. This demonstrates why checking only task.toml would falsely pass a broken seed/solution containing a credential. It is a scanner control, not a claimed app mutation or configured-judge experiment. No actual frozen-source false pass was established.
